verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs say it automatically captures next steps and action items in every meeting summary and can send them into trackers such as JIRA, Asana and ClickUp. Owner assignment is only implied by the word "assigned", and nothing documents a native in-app tracking view, so coverage of the full story is partial. missing for 10: explicit documentation that each extracted action item carries a named owner, a documented in-product place to track action-item status, independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction accuracy.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them

citations.quote: Clear next steps are automatically captured and assigned from every meeting.
Otter turns every meeting into a clear summary with decisions, action items, and insights.
Help your team move faster by sending actions items from meetings into tools they already use, like JIRA, Asana, and others.
Send meeting summaries and action items from Otter to ClickUp to manage everything in one place.
Stay on track by automatically turning your meeting notes into simple action items with deadlines.
